title: Persistent note lifecycle
expected: Saved bytes survive restart; append and delete succeed.
observed: Exact bytes preserved across process restart; duplicate create rejected; deletion verified.

title: Block/wake scheduling
expected: WAITING excluded; wake appends exactly once.
observed: P2 executes while P1 is WAITING; wake enqueues P1 once; duplicate wake rejected.

title: Empty, single, and short burst
observed: Empty run stays at tick 0; burst 1 with quantum 10 completes at tick 1.

title: 20-task capacity
observed: 20 records accepted; record 21 rejected; 20 payload bytes tracked before shutdown.

title: Exact memory budget
expected: 65,536 accepted; extra byte rejected; memory reclaimed.
observed: 65,536-byte allocation accepted; extra byte rejected; completion returns usage to zero.

title: Input validation
expected: Invalid numeric, name, oversized commands leave no partial task.
observed: 11 invalid/oversized commands rejected; next valid task gets P1; oversized tail discarded.

title: File failure recovery
observed: Missing/read/path/open errors recover; /dev/full write/close failure is reported.

title: Invalid transitions and PIDs
expected: Invalid transitions rejected without queue changes.
observed: Unknown PIDs, wake READY, and block/wake FINISHED rejected; invariants hold.

title: Forced allocation failure
expected: No PID, task, queue, or memory counter committed.
observed: Forced NULL leaves existing 10 bytes unchanged; next task gets P2 and runs normally.

title: Memory lifecycle cleanup
expected: Zero tracked payload bytes after completion/reset/exit.
observed: Completion, reset with WAITING task, and exit with READY/WAITING tasks release all payloads.

title: Study session completion
expected: Exactly one notice on actual completion.
observed: Three slices (2+2+1) complete at tick 5; console and event log each contain one notice.
